name: Chicane
description: Watch a project as a race track: each task is a corner, a task with subtasks is a chicane, and the cars are the people working on them. Finished road is paved; stalled work leaves hazards. Private by default, with optional share links.
author: Carmelo Santana

recommends.reason: shows which project members are online beside the track
adds a level and XP plate to each car from time tracked in the window
a UI for managing core "is blocked by" links; the track reads those links and puts a barrier on blocked work either way
